scripts.test: pnpm --filter @inkback/rfm test && pnpm --filter @inkback/app test && pnpm --filter @inkback/server test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @inkback/app exec vitest run --coverage && pnpm --filter @inkback/server exec vitest run --coverage
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @inkback/rfm build && pnpm --filter @inkback/app build && pnpm --filter @inkback/server build && node scripts/check-mcp-app-size.mjs && node packages/cli/build-release.mjs
